label: Bible Study
prompt: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a _____ upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.
verse: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.
note: At Jesus' baptism the Spirit descends in bodily shape like a dove — and the Father speaks.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And Elisha prayed, and said, LORD, I pray thee, open his eyes, that he may see. And the LORD opened the eyes of the young man; and he saw: and, behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of _____ round about Elisha.
verse: And Elisha prayed, and said, LORD, I pray thee, open his eyes, that he may see. And the LORD opened the eyes of the young man; and he saw: and, behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha.
note: Elisha's servant saw an enemy army all around; one prayer later, he saw the hills full of chariots of fire.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Behold, I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb; and thou shalt _____ the rock, and there shall come water out of it, that the people may drink. And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.
verse: Behold, I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb; and thou shalt smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it, that the people may drink. And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.
note: At Horeb, God said strike the rock; years later at Meribah he said speak to it — and the difference mattered.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And he said, Who art thou? And she answered, I am Ruth thine handmaid: spread therefore thy _____ over thine handmaid; for thou art a near kinsman.
verse: And he said, Who art thou? And she answered, I am Ruth thine handmaid: spread therefore thy skirt over thine handmaid; for thou art a near kinsman.
note: Ruth's bold marriage request at the threshingfloor — the Hebrew for 'skirt' is the same as the 'wings' of Ruth 2:12.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: I the LORD search the heart, I try the _____, even to give every man according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings.
verse: I the LORD search the heart, I try the reins, even to give every man according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings.
note: God searches the heart and tries the 'reins' — the old English word for kidneys, pictured as the seat of hidden motives.
